stories.title: With Oregon facing wave of school closures, Lewis & Clark launches new education policy center
stories.summary: Oregon's formula for funding school districts is under greater scrutiny as declining enrollment threatens budgets throughout the state.

stories.title: 'Don't hang up on me': How a fake deputy used a woman's own data against her
stories.summary: A so-called deputy called a Washington woman at work. Armed with her most private information, he claimed a warrant was out for her arrest. She's now warning others.

stories.title: Abernethy Bridge project hits major milestone as crews shift deck section weighing over 9,000 tons
stories.summary: One half of the bridge deck was shifted about 8 feet outward on new support piers. The other half of the deck will be moved next month, widening the overall bridge.

stories.title: Interstate Bridge project issues formal request for proposals, though only from one applicant
stories.summary: The bridge project team previously put out a request for qualifications and received only one response from a joint venture led by Kiewit Infrastructure.

stories.title: Body found near Yaquina Head belongs to pilot of crashed plane, OSP says
stories.summary: A body recovered last week belongs to Ralph Busby III, 78, who died in a plane crash off the coast of Newport in late September.

stories.title: PGE's plan for transmission lines in Forest Park again moves forward
stories.summary: A city of Portland hearings officer approved the project Friday — a hurdle it cleared once before, until city council overturned it on appeal.

stories.title: Portland wants to host the 2031 Women's World Cup. Here's what could stand in the way
stories.summary: The Rose City has the fans, history and atmosphere. But there's one thing standing between Portland and the 2031 World Cup.

stories.title: Her boyfriend went missing. Nearly two decades later, she murdered her husband
stories.summary: Nearly three years after a Portland woman killed her husband, investigators say she may be tied to the 2006 disappearance of her former boyfriend.

stories.title: Third Portland police officer shot this year, prompting frustration from police chief: 'Totally unacceptable'
stories.summary: A Portland police officer and a suspect were each injured in a shooting during a stolen car investigation in Northeast Portland.

stories.title: Seattle approves holiday decorations including Jimothy raccoon statue
stories.summary: The Seattle City Council approved a $150,000 holiday decoration project for Ballard, featuring a Jimothy the raccoon statue.

stories.title: Oregon sues X, says its AI created sexualized pictures of children
stories.summary: The social media company's AI assistant, Grok, was allegedly rolled out without safety features to prevent its misuse.

stories.title: Hiker dies on Wahkeena Falls trail in Columbia River Gorge
stories.summary: Emergency crews found a man dead on the Wahkeena Falls trail Sunday. His identity has not been released, authorities said.
